title: Oven Roasted Tunisian Tofu Bake
description: A flavorful and healthy Tunisian dish featuring wood-fired baked tofu, perfect for a weeknight dinner, and is FODMAP friendly. This recipe combines fresh ingredients with a glassy jelly like texture.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, harissa, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Transfer the tofu to a baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
While the tofu is baking, prepare the glassy jelly like sauce by mixing together 1/4 cup of water and 2 tablespoons of cornstarch in a small bowl.
After the tofu has baked for 20 minutes, brush the sauce over the top of the tofu and continue baking for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the Oven Roasted Tunisian Tofu Bake hot over rice or with some crusty bread.
